metadata.title: Gritty Urban Tunnel Portrait with Brutalist Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, distressed portrait of a male figure in a dark sweater, set within a curved urban tunnel. The scene is bathed in a sickly green light with heavy film grain and paper-fold textures. A massive, blocky, custom-lettered title in cyan dominates the center, partially obscuring the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by the receding perspective of the tunnel walls
High contrast between the dark silhouette of the subject and the bright, glowing tunnel background
Textual overlay acting as a physical barrier between the viewer and the subject
Texture of creased paper and scratches unifying the foreground type and background image
coreInvariants: Heavy digital noise and distressed paper textures
Subject in a pose of distress or contemplation

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, mid-shot, kneeling or crouching, occupying the middle third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, cyan, blocky lettering in the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright cyan text, move up to the subject's face highlighted by the tunnel light, then follow the tunnel's curve into the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners of the tunnel provide atmospheric negative space, filled with texture and graffiti.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated lime and moss green (background and skin tones).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant cyan to teal gradient (main typography).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the tunnel center, low value in the foreground subject, with high saturation reserved exclusively for the central text.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm tones like red, orange, or yellow
Maintain a cold, sterile, urban palette

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-bold, geometric sans-serif with interlocking blocks.
letterConstructionRules: Letters are constructed from thick, rectangular slabs
Zero internal counters or very minimal negative space within glyphs
Stems and bars have uniform thickness
One character is modified to resemble a cross or plus sign
characterSpecificRedesigns: The central 'T' or vertical element is extended upwards to form a cross shape
Letters are tightly kerned to the point of overlapping into a single graphic mass
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a massive, custom geometric block and a tiny, widely-spaced clean sans-serif.

preserve: The interlocking nature of the display text
The wide tracking of the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight for the display text base.
Suitable for the wide-tracked metadata text at the bottom.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic, low-angle photo of a man in a black sweater crouching in a concrete tunnel. The lighting is a sickly, monochromatic green. The image should have heavy film grain, scratches, and visible paper fold creases. The tunnel walls should have faint, blurry graffiti.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, custom-lettered word in the center using ultra-bold, interlocking geometric blocks. The word should have a cyan-to-teal gradient and a grainy texture. One central letter should be shaped like a cross. Below this, add a name in a small, white, widely-spaced extended sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the green tint consistent across the background?
Does the display text look like a solid, interlocking block?
Are the paper fold textures visible over both the image and the text?
Is the bottom text tracking sufficiently wide?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the green color grade
Amount of paper distress and fold marks
Position of the subject within the tunnel
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact graffiti patterns on the walls

avoid: Standard, unmodified system fonts for the display text

postGenerationChecks: Check that the cyan text doesn't look 'pasted on' but shares the image's grain.
Ensure the tunnel perspective leads the eye toward the center.
Confirm the paper folds look like physical damage to a printed poster.
Verify the cross-shape in the text is distinct but integrated.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Tunnel Setting + Monochromatic Green Grade + Distressed Paper Texture + Brutalist Interlocking Typography + Wide-Tracked Metadata.
